Model card: API Try Docs Blog LFM3-Audio-2B LFM3-Audio-2B is a **compact, fully featured audio model that runs locally on laptops and edge devices**. It takes text or audio as input and responds with text, speech, or both. - **Voice chat:** ask questions aloud and receive streaming replies in text and speech. For text-only responses, the model can reason before answering. Currently supports English only. - **Multilingual speech:** transcribe, synthesize, and translate speech across 18 languages. - **Audio understanding and reasoning:** interpret recordings and answer questions about the speech, sounds, and events they contain. - **Tool calling:** turn spoken requests into tool calls to control apps and devices, with text or speech alongside the calls. LFM3-Audio-2B introduces an in-house audio encoder and LiquidCodec audio tokenizer, improving speech quality over LFM2.5-Audio. Find more information about the LFM3 family in our release blog post. Model details The LFM3 family includes base, text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models. Property Specification Parameters 2B total Architecture LFM3 backbone, causal audio encoder, and LiquidCodec audio tokenizer Input Text or audio; audio encoder operates at 16 kHz Output Text, 24 kHz speech, or interleaved text and speech Context length 32K tokens (input + output) Streaming Causal audio encoding, incremental prefill, and streaming speech generation Speech languages / locales Arabic, Danish, German, Greek, British English, American English, Finnish, French, Hebrew, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish, Tu
